brief:
Gazans are prioritizing economic recovery and personal safety as Palestinian national elections approach for the first time in two decades, Al Jazeera English reported. Residents expressed hope to rebuild following widespread Israeli destruction across the territory.

The upcoming vote represents a significant moment for Palestinian governance, with voters signaling that immediate concerns about livelihoods and stability will shape their electoral choices.
dek: Ahead of first Palestinian national elections in 20 years, people in Gaza hope to rebuild after Israeli destruction.
title: Gaza voters seek jobs and security ahead of Palestinian elections
